description: Approve (which immediately publishes, schedules or queues the social draft, or publishes/schedules the blog article onto the blog) or request changes on a pending internal approval request. Call with decision: "approved" only after the user explicitly approves it.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

decision.description: "approved" publishes or schedules the social post or blog article immediately; "changes_requested" sends it back with your note.

id.description: Pending approval request id from approvals_list.

note.description: Optional reviewer feedback note, up to 500 characters.

name: approvals_decide
title: Approve or request changes
